The issue is fixed. Summary of changes to `src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php`:

- Added a `protected bool $absolute = false;` property to track whether the interval was created by a diff with the absolute flag on.
- `CarbonInterval::diff()` now records `$interval->absolute = $absolute`.
- `total()` (which backs `totalMicroseconds` used by `gt/gte/lt/lte`) now returns `abs($diff)` when the interval is absolute, instead of the sign implied by date order.
- The flag is reset in `optimize()` and `checkStartAndEnd()` so manually altered intervals fall back to normal computation.

Verification: `tests/CarbonInterval/TotalTest.php::testAbsoluteDiff` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes, and the interval suite passes consistently (429 tests). The carbon/immutable/timezone/localization and other suites pass; the only remaining failures (`CarbonPeriod\CreateTest::testStartAndEndFallback`, and the PHPStan testsuite fatal from a phpstan-phar incompatibility) pre-exist on the unmodified baseline.
